sourceNotes: No brand color-code document was found for this channel. Fetched directly from the logo pack's own pixel data via dominant-color clustering: Olive #505828 (mosque-arch silhouette, praying hands, wordmark) and Cream #F8F8F0 (badge fill). This is a deliberately restrained two-tone identity -- the artwork itself uses no third color -- so every role maps to the same two hues rather than inventing an accent that isn't present in the source.
